name: 19034 · Ft Washington, PA
findings: ZIP 19034 (Ft Washington) has 114 nonprofit organizations. 62 of them (54%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 56 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19034 (Ft Washington) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 19034 (Ft Washington) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 4.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 33 organizations here; 16% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
